violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Close boxes/bags of food items in walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Hot dog roller not provided with adequate sneeze protection.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. 3 door upright cooler near walk in freezer has items temping at 42-46 degrees F.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Hand held dust pan and broom stored on food service gloves stored on utility cart in kitchen.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Stained ceiling tiles near vent in kitchen.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Reach in prep table cooler and lower shelving part of prep table have accumulation of food debris and need detail cleaning.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. Unlabeled chemical spray bottle on lower shelf at 3 compartment sink line.
